name: opencode-tts-speak
description: OpenCode TTS plugin with Windows playback fixes and natural Markdown speech cleanup

scripts.release:patch: npm run typecheck && npm run pack:check && npm version patch && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
scripts.release:minor: npm run typecheck && npm run pack:check && npm version minor && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
